title: JCT Just Did a 6X in a Day: Here's What's Next
description: $JCT ran 6X in a single day with no news behind it, and the setup on the futures side is what could decide whether this pump keeps going.

I break down what Janction actually is, the $JASMY-incubated GPU marketplace, why roughly $1.5 billion traded on Binance perps against $321 million on spot, what the project has never made public, and the 77% of supply that has not unlocked yet.
